forward_leg.method: real_potential = exp(slope) - 1 of the log-linear fit over the stored quarters dated in the window (the trailing leg in `components` is the slope itself); raw_trend_g = max_share_of_nominal_trend x (real_potential + the trailing inflation-expectation leg); terminal_g_step = clamp, then round_to. The projection is the latest stored vintage, not point-in-time. Not used by terminal_g_suggestion.

notes: A uniform perpetual growth rate across issuers is deliberate: no company outgrows its economy forever. This anchor replaces an unsourced constant with a sourced, versioned and revisable one.

v0.3: the regime label no longer moves this anchor. terminal_g_suggestion is the published rung after a dead-band + 3-consecutive-monthly-build confirmation rule over the smoothed (trailing 12-month) inflation-expectation leg.
inflation_expectation leg taken from T5YIFR, trailing 12 months
